clips.send: A friend sends this to someone chasing raw talent instead of the right book - real awe, the surprising proof.
clips.caption:
Liberace wasn't the best piano player of his generation. He said so himself.

But he became the wealthiest - a Las Vegas superstar, an international name, more successful than players with ten times his technical skill.

Kevin Trudeau says Liberace credited one single book for the difference: The Magic of Believing, written in 1948. Not more practice. Not more talent. One book, read and applied.

What's the one resource you've been putting off that could actually change the outcome?

clips.start_words: I'm in a toxic work environment
clips.send: Someone forwards this to a coworker who blames the toxic office for everything - the same gut-punch truth, real anger.
clips.caption:
A caller told Kevin Trudeau he was stuck in a toxic work environment and felt powerless to change it.

Kevin's answer was blunt: that means you're susceptible to other people's negativity. That means you're weak. Get strong enough that you change the environment, instead of letting it change you.

He says winners are at cause over their environment. Losers are at effect, always blaming the boss, the room, the other person.

Are you running your environment, or is it running you?

#kevintrudeau #mindset #success #wealthmindset #motivation #selfimprovement

clips.start_words: Your income is going to be
clips.send: Someone sends this to a friend surrounded by people who complain and never grow - the blunt wake-up, real anxiety about who's in the room.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says your income is going to be the average of your five best friends. Not your effort alone - theirs too.

Your attitude works the same way. It mimics the people you spend the most time with.

Aristotle Onassis, once one of the richest men on Earth, said the single biggest key to his success was who he associated with. Every person puts out a frequency, and you absorb it whether you notice or not.

Who are your five best friends, and what's their average income?

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #success #mindset #money #motivation

clips.send: A friend sends this to someone who says they can't visualize or manifest anything - the quick, undeniable proof, real awe.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau did a quick demonstration on his show: don't think of a cat. Don't think of a cat.

A picture of a cat just showed up in your mind anyway - maybe white, maybe black, maybe your own cat from years ago.

Then he asked people to describe their living room couch. Every single person could see it, in full color, in their mind, instantly.

Kevin says that's the whole secret behind manifesting what you want: you already have the ability to picture anything clearly. Most people just never point it at their goals.

#kevintrudeau #manifestation #mindset #lawofattraction #success #motivation

clips.start_words: I feel like I'm swimming upstream
clips.send: A friend sends this to someone who feels blocked from making money no matter how hard they try - real anxiety, the answer they want.
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau once ran a direct mail campaign, spent his own money on ads, and sold nothing. He lost several thousand dollars - real money in the early 1970s.

His uncle told him something strange: there was an energetic block stopping the money from coming in, no matter how good his technique was.

Kevin went through a single process to release it. Then he sent out the exact same ad, with one or two words changed in the headline.

Orders poured in by the hundreds. Within a week, he'd made back everything he'd lost.

#kevintrudeau #wealthmindset #mindset #success #money #motivation
